services.name: Sunset Sails
services.desc: Our sailing curriculum is designed to meet the needs of each individual. Some people are looking for an introduction to sailing and others are wanting to prepare to bareboat in remote locations such as the Virgin Islands. There are many sailing certification courses available each of which have different levels of recognition within and outside of the United States. The most recognized is that offered by the United States Coast Guard. If you are looking for a certification, you need to closely study the credentials offered by each of the organizations offering certification and then make your selection.
